Method of Attack: Delivered via malspam emails containing malicious URLs or Microsoft Word and Excel attachments with Visual Basic macros
Macros connect to compromised Microsoft SQL Servers using SQLOLEDB connector
Downloads malware stored as ASCII-encoded strings in MSSQL database
Decodes and writes malware as PKZIP archive to system hard drive
Extracted binary launches installation of final malware payload
Uses detection evasion techniques including code obfuscation, string case alteration, misspelled variables, StrReverse function, and randomized strings
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows systems running Microsoft Office
Attack Vector: Malspam emails with malicious URLs or Microsoft Office document attachments containing VBA macros
Indicators of Compromise: C2 server domains and IP addresses listed in Proofpoint's WhiteShadow report
Malware sample hashes available on VirusTotal and AlienVault
